category: POV: you're an adult and nobody warned you
quote: POV: you realize your favorite hobby is just sitting in silence. You spend all week waiting for Friday just to be tired on Saturday. Suddenly you have strong opinions about which trash bags are the best. Your weekend plans now revolve entirely around whether or not you have pants. Turns out being an adult is mostly just aggressively protecting your personal alone time.
